Full deployment
Configure the pilot group in Step 3 or add groups to expand beyond the pilot and

Defender for Identity provides powerful protection on its own. However, when combined with
the other capabilities of Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint provides data into the
shared signals which together help stop attacks.
Here's an example of a cyber-attack and how the components of Microsoft Defender XDR help
detect and mitigate it.
Defender for Endpoint detects device and network vulnerabilities that might otherwise be
exploited for devices managed by your organization.
Microsoft Defender XDR correlates the signals from all the Microsoft Defender components to
provide the full attack story.
